boundary: This ledger records bounded workflow evidence. Same-owner validation is not independent reproduction and does not establish scientific, legal, cultural, identity, production, security, accessibility, deployment, or Stage 20 claims.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Treat the memory registry filename as a lead, then resolve one bounded suffix match before reading the rollout summary.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Use an exact filename first, then at most one suffix-scoped rg --files recovery; never broad-scan private rollout content.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the stale pointer zero read credit, retain the miss, and stop if the bounded suffix search is not unique.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Same-owner memory lookup recovery only; no authority, identity continuity, or repository evidence credit.
preferred_methods.title: Resolve stale memory rollout pointers with one bounded suffix search
trigger_preconditions: A current memory registry entry names a rollout summary that is absent at that exact path.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Split local Git facts, ancestry, live remote, and owned-lane probes into small no-profile invocations.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Keep network and local Git probes separate and disable the login profile for bounded verification commands.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the grouped audit zero verification credit and make no branch change until every isolated probe passes.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Read-only Git verification only; no merge, rewrite, force push, sibling mutation, or independent reproduction credit.
preferred_methods.title: Isolate local, ancestry, live-remote, and owned-lane Git probes
trigger_preconditions: A grouped Windows Git audit approaches or exceeds its supervision budget.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Resolve commit trees once and read each unique blob with one flushed request followed by its complete response.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Build one ls-tree map per commit and use strict request-flush-read framing; never write all batch requests before reading.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the timed wrapper with zero aggregate pass credit and do not reuse a blocking batch transport.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Immutable Git-blob parity only; no full-suite, independent reproduction, production, privacy-complete, or security-complete credit.
preferred_methods.title: Verify manifests with tree maps and one-request blob framing
trigger_preconditions: Hundreds of immutable Git blobs require exact byte, digest, blob-ID, and path-set comparison.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Bind assertions to the committed workflow and reflection schemas and compare semantic boundary phrases case-insensitively.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Inspect frozen JSON keys before assertions and reserve exact string checks for normative machine labels, not prose capitalization.
preferred_methods.rollback: Retain the first suite with zero aggregate pass credit and change no phase data or implementation to satisfy a stale test assumption.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local x1 test repair only; no x2, scientific, production, accessibility-complete, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.

trigger_preconditions: A test fails because its asserted key or prose casing differs from the committed current schema or equivalent boundary text.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Resolve the owned worktree from the bounded worktree bank and pass its absolute path as the working directory for every repository command.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Before any staged review or mutation after a resumed turn, prove the explicit owned worktree path, branch, and head; never infer repository context from the process default directory.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the mismatched-directory probe zero repository credit, retain the miss, and perform no staging until the owned lane is explicitly resolved.
preferred_methods.scope_boundary: Owner-local workspace recovery only; no sibling mutation, x2, scientific, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.
preferred_methods.title: Bind resumed repository work to the explicit owned worktree
trigger_preconditions: A resumed shell or compacted turn may have lost its prior repository working directory.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Read the subcommand help and pass the documented --receipt path rather than assuming the summarizer and validator share an output option.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Interrogate each runner subcommand independently; do not infer option parity between summarize and validate.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the rejected validation invocation zero validation credit, preserve the already successful append-only operations, and retry only the validator with its documented receipt option.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Assert the frozen minimum Method Flow evidence and the invariant that every recorded method is preferred, rather than binding a successor-capable test to a transient exact count.
preferred_methods.recurrence_guard: Use exact counts only for immutable commit-blob receipts; use declared minimums and semantic invariants for live lifecycle ledgers.
preferred_methods.rollback: Give the failed rebuilt suite zero aggregate credit, retain the obsolete assertion, and change no proposal or outcome data.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Anchor live-ledger assertions to evidence that already existed before the recovering method began; never require a method's own future passing witness as a precondition for running its acceptance check.

preferred_methods.rollback: Give the circular targeted assertion zero credit, retain M07 as candidate, and append no passing witness until a noncircular bounded check succeeds.

preferred_methods.candidate_workaround: Execute each frozen proposal group through its family-current runner, then run portfolios and aggregate current-phase validation only after every group witness passes.
